title: rinorea spinosa
intro: Rinorea spinosa, commonly known as the Spiny Rinorea or Velvet Vine, is a plant species in the family Violaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and sore throat. The therapeutic actions of Rinorea spinosa are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. Bioactive constituents of Rinorea spinosa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may contribute to its potential health benefits.
